run_singlepoint_calculations: run singlepoint energy and force calculations on a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_chunked_structures: calculate properties for a chunk of atomic structures split across multiple array jobs
write_results_to_json: write singlepoint calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a results directory
init_singlepoint_runner: initialize a SinglePointRunner with an ASE calculator, input data, and properties to calculate
save_checkpoint_state: save the checkpoint state of a SinglePointRunner for preemption recovery
